hyd-001.quote: The aircraft has three, independent, continuously-operating hydraulic systems : GREEN, BLUE, and YELLOW.

hyd-002.quote: Normal system operating pressure is 3 000 PSI (2 500 PSI for RAT).

hyd-003.quote: There is no possibility to transfer hydraulic fluid from one system to another.

hyd-004.quote: Two pumps, respectively driven by each engine pressurize the green system.

hyd-005.quote: A pump, driven by a Ram Air Turbine (RAT), pressurizes the green system in the event of an emergency.

elec-001.quote: Each generator can supply up to 115 KVA of three phase 115/200 V

elec-002.quote: can replace one or more main engine generators at any time.

elec-003.quote: The green hydraulic circuit drives an emergency generator

elec-004.quote: This generator supplies 8 KVA of three-phase 115/200 V 400 Hz power, except when the Ram Air Turbine powers the green hydraulic
circuit, and the aircraft speed is below 260 kt; in this case, the emergency generator supplies 3.5 KVA, leading to some shedding.

elec-005.quote: In flight, the inverter is automatically activated, if nothing but the batteries is supplying electrical power to the aircraft,

fuel-001.quote: Fuel is stored in the : ‐ Wings ‐ Center section ‐ Trimmable Horizontal Stabilizer (THS).

fuel-002.quote: Is maintained full and contains about 1 000 kg (2 200 lb) of fuel.

fuel-003.quote: When split valves are closed, the fuel contained in the AFT section of INNER tanks is still usable via the standby pumps.

fuel-005.quote: The fuel system is controlled by two Fuel Control and Monitoring Computers (FCMC).

brk-001.quote: The normal system uses green hydraulic pressure

brk-002.quote: the alternate system uses the blue hydraulic system (backed up by the hydraulic accumulator).

brk-003.quote: A changeover between the two BSCU systems takes place at each DOWN landing lever selection, or in case one system fails.

pneu-001.quote: High pressure air is supplied from three sources : ‐ Engine bleed systems ‐ APU load compressor ‐ Two HP ground connections.

pneu-002.quote: Each system is controlled and monitored by one Bleed Monitoring Computer.

pneu-003.quote: The APU bleed supply is controlled by the APU Electronic Control Box (ECB).
